title: Achievability of Heterogeneous Hypergraph Recovery from its Graph Projection
summary: We formulate and analyze a heterogeneous random hypergraph model, and we provide an achieveability result for recovery of hyperedges from the observed projected graph. We observe a projected graph which combines random hyperedges across all degrees, where a projected edge appears if and only if both vertices appear in at least one hyperedge. Our goal is to reconstruct the original set of hyperedges of degree $d_j$ for some $j$.
